_doc: Painted-head envelope. 'vanilla*' blocks are MEASURED (fit_head_canvas.py vanilla <dir of extracted Core heads> --write; 2026-10-20 from RimWorldWin64_Data/resources.assets, 128 px canvases, alpha>20). 'limits' are the PROPOSED allowances (FOUNDRY 2026-10-20, owner approved the effort, not each number): ratios are to the vanilla Average-head median per facing; overhangs are fractions of vanilla head height; tolerances are canvas fractions. species_overrides: {species dir name: {limit: value}} for a species the owner rules may exceed a limit (e.g. Rakata eye-stalks). SKULL vs BBOX (owner 2026-10-20, centre on the skull mass): 'vanilla_skull' is the same Average heads measured by the skull-mass detector; height_ratio_*, below_chin_max, chin_rise_max, center_x_tol and the facing tolerances judge the SKULL against it; width_ratio_*, top_overhang_max (above the vanilla crown), appendage_below_chin_max (below the vanilla chin, in vanilla skull heights) and canvas_margin judge the appendage-inclusive BBOX. Design: design/RimStarWars/head_envelope_2026-10-20.md.

species_overrides._doc: PROPOSED (FOUNDRY 2026-10-20) under the owner's skull-mass ruling ('center the head regardless of additional appendages such as horns, ears, or anything else'): the SKULL is sized and seated to vanilla, and the ears of these species are left free beyond the general appendage allowance. Ortolan below_chin_max/facing_height_tol: its back view (north) carries a nape below the dome that the trunk hides on the front, so its north skull reads ~1.27x the south; the facings are aligned on the CROWN (fit --anchor north-crown) and the nape hangs below the vanilla chin. The owner may move any number.

known_violations._doc: Violations that are REAL and stay visible (check prints them as KNOWN and does not fail on them; a known violation that no longer occurs FAILS as stale, so this list cannot outlive the defect). Each names the item that owns the fix. Not a limit change.
Ortolan: ORTOLAN_SIDE_EAR_REDRAW_OUTGROWS_ITS_CANVAS: the side-view ear is ~25% longer than the front-view ear, so with the skull at vanilla height it runs off the canvas bottom; the side view is drawn at 0.74 of vanilla skull height until the ear is repainted (cosmetic: owner permission first)
